Hotkeys_Lead.Text: Click a key field and press a new key to change it. Actions sharing a key are marked “Duplicate”.
Hotkeys_CaptureHint.Text: Select a key field and press your shortcut. Esc cancels; Backspace or Delete removes it. Include Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or Win.
Hotkeys_ConflictHint.Text: Checks for conflicts when you assign keys or open this page. Keys registered as hotkeys by another app are marked “In use”.
Hotkeys_WinHint.Text: For shortcuts with Win, Snapwell sends one unassigned key to stop the Start menu from opening.
Hotkeys.ConflictsHint: Multiple actions share the same key
Hotkeys.Anchor.CenterDescription: The center stays fixed. Both sides move
Hotkeys.Anchor.NearEdgeDescription: The edge nearest the work area boundary stays fixed. The far edge moves
Hotkeys.Anchor.TopLeftDescription: The top left stays fixed. The right and bottom edges move
Hotkeys.Anchor.Note: Anchor: {name}. {description}. Change it in Grid and gaps.
Hotkeys.Capture.Busy: Another settings window is capturing a key
Hotkeys.Capture.ModifierRequired: Include Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or Win
Hotkeys.Capture.InUseMessage: {chord} is used by another app or Windows. Assigning it may stop it working there. Windows-reserved keys may not reach Snapwell.
